# Review #221

Verdict: **ACCEPT the baseline design as preparation evidence**, reviewed at commit `3129c60033d3ad7ad1c1ffc0979462b97e016910`; the three reviewed files are unchanged at session HEAD `9c38c9245d99ba50625737d5c093537937de0ad3`.

## Standards

1. No actionable standards findings in the assigned scope. The checker keeps a frozen field inventory independent of its input (`benchmark/scripts/baseline.py:9`), and the README explicitly limits its structural guarantee (`benchmark/baseline/README.md:11`).

## Spec

2. No missing or superfluous manifest fields found against `benchmark/protocol.md` baseline and `docs/perpetua/evaluation.md`: identity/prompts/inputs/versions map to `benchmark/baseline/run-manifest.template.json:4–23`; matched budgets and repetition planning to lines 24–35; isolation/preservation to 36–39; scoring/probes/coverage to 40–50; time/cost to 51–56; tolerances, uncertainty and owner acceptance to 57–65. All 62 run-specific fields remain null with reasons.
3. The README assigns no numeric repetition count, quality threshold, spending or readiness; it names accepted cases/keys/split, tested isolation, verified quota and reviewed scorer as blockers (`benchmark/baseline/README.md:15,25`). Recipient/retention checks, restricted records and existing-resource spending limits respect accepted limits (lines 7,15,18).
4. Independent verification passed: `python3 -I benchmark/scripts/baseline.py --check` reported 62 undecided fields. Two in-memory mutations were rejected with exactly `missing field: provider` and `provider: undecided value must be null`; no files were edited by these checks.
5. The read-only `git show iter/0025/215:benchmark/challenges/README.md` confirms the diagram-difference row names before/after revisions of the same VI, native diagram evidence for both and an independently established difference key, while keeping the case in scope (tagged file, line 24). No fixture audits were repeated.

Quality remains unmeasured: no paired runs or development pilots exist. Native/probe evidence, accepted keys/split, tested isolation, model quota, runner/scorer and family/version/target coverage remain unresolved; the diagram-difference control is absent. Structural validity establishes no benchmark or product readiness.

Next Policymaker: arrange pinning of the reviewed design as preparation evidence and order prerequisite work. A populated manifest still needs a separately reviewed validation contract; do not treat this template check as execution approval or repeat review #212's fixture audits.

No changes to merge.
